title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Yogurt-marinated chicken charred under the broiler, then simmered in a creamy, spiced tomato sauce. Serve with rice or naan.

image.alt: A bowl of chicken tikka masala with a cream swirl, beside rice

steps.text: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, half the garam masala, the grated garlic and the salt. Marinate in the fridge for at least {time 30 min notimer}, or up to overnight.

Heat the broiler with a rack about {len 6 in} from the heat. Spread the chicken on a foil-lined baking sheet and broil, turning once, until charred in spots, {time 10-12 min}. It will finish in the sauce.

Melt the butter in the skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion until soft and golden, {time 8-10 min}. Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, turmeric, cayenne and the rest of the garam masala and stir for {time 1 min}.
Add the tomato sauce and salt and simmer, stirring, until thick and darker, {time 10 min}. Stir in the cream.
Add the chicken and its juices and simmer gently until cooked through, {time 8-10 min}. The thickest piece should read {temp 165F internal}. Scatter with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

notes: Freezes well for up to 3 months. The sauce thickens in the fridge; loosen with water when reheating.
